films.title: The Insider
films.summary: A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE INSIDER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MICHAEL MANN // 1999</text></svg>

films.title: Lost Highway
films.summary: A tormented jazz musician finds himself lost in an enigmatic story involving murder, surveillance, gangsters, doppelgängers, and an impossible transformation inside a prison cell.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LOST HIGHWAY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">DAVID LYNCH // 1997</text></svg>

films.title: Nightcrawler
films.summary: When Lou Bloom, desperate for work, muscles into the world of L.A. crime journalism, he blurs the line between observer and participant to become the star of his own story. Aiding him in his effort is Nina, a TV-news veteran.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NIGHTCRAWLER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">DAN GILROY // 2014</text></svg>

films.title: Possible Love
films.summary: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">POSSIBLE LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LEE CHANG-DONG // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Somewhere in the Night
films.summary: George Taylor returns from WWII with amnesia. Back home in Los Angeles, while trying to track down his old identity, he stumbles onto a three year old murder case and a hunt for a missing $2 million.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SOMEWHERE IN THE NIGHT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JOSEPH L. MANKIEWICZ // 1946</text></svg>

films.title: Detour
films.summary: The life of Al Roberts, a pianist in a New York nightclub, turns into a nightmare when he decides to hitchhike to Los Angeles to visit his girlfriend.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DETOUR</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">EDGAR G. ULMER // 1945</text></svg>

films.title: The Devils
films.summary: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE DEVILS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">KEN RUSSELL // 1971</text></svg>

films.title: Network
films.summary: When veteran anchorman Howard Beale is forced to retire his 25-year post because of his age, he announces to viewers that he will kill himself during his farewell broadcast. Network executives rethink their decision when his fanatical tirade results in a spike in ratings.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NETWORK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">SIDNEY LUMET // 1976</text></svg>

films.title: Bitter Christmas
films.summary: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BITTER CHRISTMAS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PEDRO ALMODÓVAR // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Landlord
films.summary: At the age of twenty-nine, Elgar Enders "runs away" from home. This running away consists of buying a building in a black ghetto in the Park Slope section of Brooklyn. Initially, his intention is to evict the black tenants and convert the building into a posh flat. But Elgar is not one to be bound by yesterday's urges, and soon he has other thoughts on his mind.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE LANDLORD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HAL ASHBY // 1970</text></svg>

films.title: The Holy Mountain
films.summary: The Alchemist assembles together a group of people from all walks of life to represent the planets in the solar system. The occult adept's intention is to put his recruits through strange mystical rites and divest them of their worldly baggage before embarking on a trip to Lotus Island. There they ascend the Holy Mountain to displace the immortal gods who secretly rule the universe.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HOLY MOUNTAIN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALEJANDRO JODOROWSKY // 1973</text></svg>

films.title: The Celebration
films.summary: The family of a wealthy businessman gather to celebrate his 60th birthday. During the course of the party, his eldest son presents a speech that reveals a devastating secret that turns the night into a battle of truth and denial.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE CELEBRATION</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THOMAS VINTERBERG // 1998</text></svg>

films.title: Primetime
films.summary: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PRIMETIME</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">LANCE OPPENHEIM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.summary: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">NATHAN FIELDER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
films.summary: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NOAH SEGAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: To Die For
films.summary: Suzanne Stone wants to be a world-famous news anchor and she is willing to do anything to get what she wants. What she lacks in intelligence, she makes up for in cold determination and diabolical wiles. As she pursues her goal with relentless focus, she is forced to destroy anything and anyone that may stand in her way, regardless of the ultimate cost or means necessary.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TO DIE FOR</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">GUS VAN SANT // 1995</text></svg>

films.title: Paper Tiger
films.summary: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAPER TIGER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JAMES GRAY // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Cloverfield
films.summary: Five young New Yorkers throw their friend a going-away party the night that a monster the size of a skyscraper descends upon the city. Told from the point of view of their video camera, the film is a document of their attempt to survive the most surreal, horrifying event of their lives.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLOVERFIELD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MATT REEVES // 2008</text></svg>

films.title: All of a Sudden
films.summary: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALL OF A SUDDEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">RYUSUKE HAMAGUCHI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: NAZA
films.summary: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NAZA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YUVAL ABRAHAM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Woman on the Beach
films.summary: A sailor suffering from post-traumatic stress becomes involved with a beautiful and enigmatic seductress married to a blind painter.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE WOMAN ON THE BEACH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JEAN RENOIR // 1947</text></svg>

films.title: Fatherland
films.summary: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FATHERLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">PAWEŁ PAWLIKOWSKI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Maurice
films.summary: After his lover rejects him, Maurice attempts to come to terms with his sexuality within the restrictiveness of Edwardian society.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MAURICE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JAMES IVORY // 1987</text></svg>

films.title: Over the Hedge
films.summary: A scheming raccoon fools a mismatched family of forest creatures into helping him repay a debt of food, by invading the new suburban sprawl that popped up while they were hibernating – and learns a lesson about family himself.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">OVER THE HEDGE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">KAREY KIRKPATRICK // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: Club Kid
films.summary: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CLUB KID</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JORDAN FIRSTMAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Mouse
films.summary: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MOUSE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">KELLY O'SULLIVAN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Wild Bunch
films.summary: An aging group of outlaws look for one last big score as the "traditional" American West is disappearing around them.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE WILD BUNCH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">SAM PECKINPAH // 1969</text></svg>

films.title: The Souvenir
films.summary: A shy but ambitious film student falls into an intense, emotionally fraught relationship with a charismatic but untrustworthy older man.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE SOUVENIR</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JOANNA HOGG // 2019</text></svg>

films.title: The History of Concrete
films.summary: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOHN WILSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Zi
films.summary: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ZI</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">KOGONADA // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
films.summary: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PORTRAIT OF A LADY ON FIRE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">CÉLINE SCIAMMA // 2019</text></svg>

films.title: Tenebrae
films.summary: On the last day for the residents to vacate a high-rise apartment before its demolishment, a young girl, Iris, and her mother are moving out. On a tight deadline, her boyfriend and his friend are also present to help. Iris inevitably gets distracted exploring the vacant spaces of her neighbours, relishing the moment. As they pull away in the rental truck for the last time, Iris sits in the back with her boyfriend, surrounded by her furniture. She allows a small ray of light to penetrate the darkness of the truck. The images of the outside world appear on the interior of the truck; they watch the inverted building before it eventually disappears forever.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TENEBRAE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">NICOLE MIDORI WOODFO // 2018</text></svg>

films.title: The State of Things
films.summary: On location in Portugal, a film crew runs out of film while making their own version of Roger Corman's The Day the World Ended (1956). The producer is nowhere to be found and director Munro attempts to find him in hopes of being able to finish the film.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE STATE OF THINGS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">WIM WENDERS // 1982</text></svg>

films.title: La Bola Negra
films.summary: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

films.title: The Reflecting Skin
films.summary: In 1950s rural Idaho, a young boy watches helplessly as his friends and brother fall under the spell of a mysterious widow living up the road and becomes convinced that she is a vampire.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE REFLECTING SKIN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">PHILIP RIDLEY // 1990</text></svg>

films.title: Benedetta
films.summary: A 17th-century nun becomes entangled in a forbidden lesbian affair with a novice. But it is Benedetta's shocking religious visions that threaten to shake the Church to its core.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">BENEDETTA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PAUL VERHOEVEN // 2021</text></svg>

films.title: In Bed with Victoria
films.summary: Victoria is a thirty-something divorced lawyer who's struggling to raise her two daughters. She is canny and cynical but on the verge of an emotional breakdown. At a friend's wedding she reconnects with Vincent, an old friend, and Sam, an old client. Her life is about to take a new turn.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">IN BED WITH VICTORIA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JUSTINE TRIET // 2016</text></svg>

films.title: Raunchy Late Night Theatre
films.summary: Choong-shik, who works in a small movie theater projection room in a small town in the province, has an eccentric personality, stupid appearance and messy clothes, and no one likes him. Jung-min starts to show late-night movies at the command of the president and has been seen frequently since one day. The first time he speaks, he gets closer to Jung-min. As he gets closer to Jung-min, Choong-shik feels himself changing, and his appearance changes as well. But it feels like you are out of touch with reality. Choong-cheok ignores those feelings and decides to enjoy the moment. It is because he does not want to miss Jeong-min, who is like an angel from heaven, to Chung-sik, who has been living alone every day since his wife ran away.  Chung-sik and Jeong-min are getting closer. What is the end of those two?

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.summary: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WILD HORSE NINE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN MCDONAGH // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: And Your Bird Can Sing
films.summary: With a contagious sense of abandon, three young adults' lives become intimately entangled over the course of a long summer in Hakodate, Hokkaido.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AND YOUR BIRD CAN SING</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">SHO MIYAKE // 2018</text></svg>

films.title: Slither
films.summary: A small town is taken over by an alien plague, turning residents into zombies and all forms of mutant monsters.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SLITHER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JAMES GUNN // 2006</text></svg>

films.title: Losing Ground
films.summary: Adapted from the critically acclaimed New York stage play presented by Tom Noonan, LOSING GROUND unfolds in real-time over a single night in a Las Vegas video-poker bar where seven people come in, interact, strike up friendships of convenience, win, lose, and go home. Bryan Wizemann's haunting and elegiac feature film debut is a contemporary portrait of ritual and superstition, intimacy and estrangement. In direct contrast with the current zeitgeist of a Las Vegas myth, LOSING GROUND is a personal and closely observed work on the addictions of human nature.

films.title: The Gorilla
films.summary: Ruby has been trained in martial arts by her father and now has a job safeguarding a wide range of people and their valuables. A clumsy artist named Adelmo falls for Ruby at first sight but remains clueless about her profession. Things are complicated by Adelmo’s French neighbor and sometime model having a crush on him, and Ruby’s father trying to hook up his daughter with various body builders while putting the moves on the French girl.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE GORILLA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">ROMOLO GUERRIERI // 1982</text></svg>

films.title: Master of the Flying Guillotine
films.summary: A one-armed martial arts master is being stalked by an Imperial assassin, the master of two fighters  killed in the previous film. When the One-Armed Boxer is invited to attend a martial arts tournament, his efforts to lay low are unsuccessful, and the assassin soon tracks him down with the help of his three subordinates: a Thai boxer, a yoga master, and a kobojutsu user.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MASTER OF THE FLYING GUILLOTINE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">JIMMY WANG YU // 1976</text></svg>

films.title: The Court Jester
films.summary: A hapless carnival performer masquerades as the court jester as part of a plot against a usurper who has overthrown the rightful king of England.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE COURT JESTER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">NORMAN PANAMA // 1955</text></svg>

films.title: Playback
films.summary: While digging into their town's infamous past, a group of high school students unwittingly unlock an even darker secret. Now, an evil spirit has been awakened and will stop at nothing to find his true heir.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PLAYBACK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MICHAEL A. NICKLES // 2012</text></svg>

films.title: The Meetings of Anna
films.summary: Detached filmmaker Anna Silver arrives in Germany to show her latest film; over the course of some days, she encounters a variety of new and old faces, some of whom make personal revelations to her to little affect.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE MEETINGS OF ANNA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">CHANTAL AKERMAN // 1978</text></svg>

films.title: THE COCKPIT
films.summary: In a small cockpit-like room, we see two young hip hop musicians from Tokyo giving birth to a beat: precision, patience and camaraderie hold sway, midway between an installation and sitcom.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE COCKPIT</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SHO MIYAKE // 2015</text></svg>

films.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
films.summary: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ONCE UPON A TIME IN HARLEM</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">DAVID GREAVES // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: I Love You, Man
films.summary: Peter Klaven is a successful real estate agent who, upon getting engaged to the woman of his dreams, Zooey, discovers, to his dismay and chagrin, that he has no male friend close enough to serve as his Best Man. Peter immediately sets out to rectify the situation, embarking on a series of bizarre and awkward "man-dates."
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">I LOVE YOU, MAN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOHN HAMBURG // 2009</text></svg>

films.title: All the Long Nights
films.summary: Misa, battling PMS and stigma, starts anew at Kurita Optics. Amidst work and sweets, she meets Takatoshi. Despite his quiet demeanor and struggle with panic attacks, a deep bond forms.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ALL THE LONG NIGHTS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SHO MIYAKE // 2024</text></svg>

films.title: American Baby
films.summary: A Filipino immigrant and her charismatic American husband, a casket salesman, share a life shaped by sacrifice and silence, as their child revisits the fragile promise of the American Dream inside the quiet fractures of their marriage.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AMERICAN BABY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RAYMOND KNUDSEN // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Domestic Disturbance
films.summary: Frank Morrison is a divorced father with a 12-year-old son, Danny. His ex-wife Susan and son Danny now live with Rick Barnes, Susan's new husband. Danny, who has a reputation for telling lies, accuses his stepfather of committing a murder. Initially, no one believes his accusations, but then Frank becomes convinced and is the only one who believes him. Now, the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears.

films.title: Quarter
films.summary: Kelly, a young woman living with Type 1 diabetes, is about to turn 25, as she deals with the ups and downs of her blood sugar levels and the ups and downs of her personal life.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">QUARTER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">KELSEY BASCOM // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
films.summary: Hidden Colors 6 examines overlooked stories of Black American resistance, resilience, innovation and cultural survival.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HIDDEN COLORS 6: THE CULTURE OF RESISTANCE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TARIQ NASHEED // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Soul Patrol
films.summary: From deep behind enemy lines, a hidden chapter of American military history is uncovered, prompting the question of whether reckoning with the past can bring peace to those who lived it. The Vietnam War’s first Black special operations team reunites to tell their story.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SOUL PATROL</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">J.M. films.title: threeASFOUR: FULL CIRCLE
films.summary: For threeASFOUR, fashion is an act of creativity, collaboration and cultural connection. But after more than two decades of acclaim, can three artists who refuse to sell out survive in an industry built on compromise?

films.title: Crystal Voyager
films.summary: A loose biography of surfer and documentarist George Greenough, one of the most famous and unique members of the surfing subculture.

films.summary: Playing at Metrograph.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">WALLACE & GROMIT: THE CLASSIC SHORTS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">UNKNOWN // Classic</text></svg>

films.title: Shutter Island
films.summary: World War II soldier-turned-U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels investigates the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane, but his efforts are compromised by troubling visions and a mysterious doctor.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SHUTTER ISLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MARTIN SCORSESE // 2010</text></svg>

films.title: Thelma & Louise
films.summary: Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.

films.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
films.summary: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE KILLING OF A SACRED DEER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">YORGOS LANTHIMOS // 2017</text></svg>

films.title: Drive - The Pretenders
films.summary: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.
